maturityNote: Clamped at creation. Per CMA-002R + SUAF-001, createMemory may write at most M0/M1; any higher level must go through promote() with derived evidence.
statement: On 2026-08-27 MALACHII ran VS001, its first governed execution against real work: it probed host capability by observation, built and served the live FutureDeskAI site, measured it with real Chromium across 8 routes x 2 viewports, ran the website-factory skill deterministic auditor (PASS, 0 errors), derived a seven-dimension Quality Floor of 6, and the release gate correctly HELD with stage NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED.

sourceRefs.detail: capability manifest produced by invocation, not declaration
deterministic Python validator shipped with the skill
next build exit status and prerender count

lessons.claim: A skill validator that encodes the release contract catches an overclaim a narrative would have carried through. VS001 initially asserted BUILD_ARTIFACT; validate_website_packet.py rejected it because any promoted stage requires all seven dimensions >= 9, and the measured floor was 6.
lessons.proposedProceduralChange: Derive release stage from the validator contract; never assign it by narrative judgement.
lessons.regressionCheck: packet with floor<9 and stage!=NOT_RELEASE_QUALIFIED must fail validation

lessons.claim: browser.render reached A3_OBSERVED on this host, closing a boundary RC1.6.2 explicitly lists as unverified in its own build host.
lessons.proposedProceduralChange: Record host-specific capability observations; capability truth is per-host and per-time, never inherited from a package claim.
lessons.regressionCheck: capability probe must re-observe, never read a cached assurance

lessons.claim: Measured accessibility gaps exist on the live site: 14 distinct interactive elements below the WCAG 2.2 AA 24px minimum at 390px, no skip link on 8/8 pages, and an h1->h3 heading skip on /products.
lessons.proposedProceduralChange: Add these as tracked defects for the next website-factory build round.

authorityNote: This record informs. It grants nothing. No capability, permission, release approval, or constitutional change follows from its existence (MEMF Memory Authority Matrix).
truthBoundary: Single host, single point in time, lab measurement only. Not field data, not a conformance certification, not a deployed-endpoint result.
